task: Switch Falco modern_ebpf from privileged=true to leastPrivileged=true with explicit capabilities, RuntimeDefault seccomp, allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, and narrow the Falco CIS acceptance rules.

events.summary: Not verified: HA/Kakao nodes and kernel upgrades (BTF/capability behaviour). Live single-node checks are in e10.

provenance: Pulled upstream chart falco-9.2.1.tgz from https://falcosecurity.github.io/charts into .review/charts and inspected templates/pod-template.tpl and values.yaml.
Research report .review/research-l4.md section 2 (D-FALCO-LEAST-PRIV) and prior live measurement of privileged CapEff 000001ffffffffff and D-falco-rofs.
events.summary: Chart falco-9.2.1 templates/pod-template.tpl replaces the computed container securityContext when containerSecurityContext is non-empty and adds pod annotation container.apparmor.security.beta.kubernetes.io/falco: unconfined when driver.modernEbpf.leastPrivileged is true.

Before the change, falco.yaml ran with driver.modernEbpf.leastPrivileged=false and containerSecurityContext.privileged=true (CapEff 000001ffffffffff), leaving KSV001, KSV003, KSV004, KSV017, KSV030, and KSV104 failing on DaemonSet/falco.
evidence: test:helm template falco .review/charts/falco with previous falco.yaml values -> container securityContext {privileged: true, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true}, no pod seccompProfile
test:trivy config on previous rendered DaemonSet/falco -> KSV001, KSV003, KSV004, KSV017, KSV030, KSV104 failing

events.summary: Set driver.modernEbpf.leastPrivileged=true, podSecurityContext.seccompProfile.type=RuntimeDefault, and containerSecurityContext with allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, readOnlyRootFilesystem=true, capabilities.drop=[ALL], capabilities.add=[BPF, SYS_RESOURCE, PERFMON, SYS_PTRACE] in falco.yaml (D-FALCO-LEAST-PRIV). Narrowed cfg:security-system:DaemonSet:falco:accept in compliance-acceptance-rules.json by removing KSV001, KSV003, KSV017 and adding KSV002 and KSV022 with preserved+appended en/ko reasons and docs table parity. Updated R371 and added R421.
